---
title: "Interactive 3D Prediction Model"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

df <- read_excel("data.xlsx")

predict_output <- function(x1, x2, x3) {
  0.5 * x1 + 0.3 * x2 + 2 * x3
}
```

## Create user inputs

```{r, echo=FALSE}
numericInput("x1", "Variable 1:", value = 20)
numericInput("x2", "Variable 2:", value = 30)
numericInput("x3", "Variable 3:", value = 5)
```

### Display predicted output

```{r, echo=FALSE}
renderText({
  req(input$x1, input$x2, input$x3)

  paste("Predicted output:",
        round(predict_output(input$x1, input$x2, input$x3), 3))
})
```

## Create 3D interactive plot

```{r, echo=FALSE}
renderPlotly({
  req(input$x1, input$x2, input$x3)

  plot_ly(
    df,
    x = ~Variable1,
    y = ~Variable2,
    z = ~Variable3,
    color = ~Output,
    colors = "Viridis",
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers"
  ) %>%
    add_trace(
      x = input$x1, y = input$x2, z = input$x3,
      type = "scatter3d",
      mode = "markers",
      marker = list(size = 10, color = "orange1"),
      name = "Selected Prediction",
      inherit = FALSE
    )
})
```
